overall_reason: Cards stretch to their longest text, logical properties and :lang rules are in place and the page is fast, but seven font files weigh 855 KiB and the header buttons have little room for longer labels.

score.reason: T-WIDTHS and T-HOSTILE-CONTENT pass, but T-WEIGHT-FOR-JOB fails on fonts (ROB-018) and T-TRANSLATE on two fixed header buttons (ROB-011).

findings.title: Weight fits the page's job
findings.evidence: performance.by_kind.font: 7 files, 855 KiB; against_budgets marks font_files and font_kib as fail (budgets 4 to 6 files, 160 to 320 KiB). The heaviest are AnthropicSerif_Roman 171 KiB, AnthropicSerif_Italic 163 KiB, JetBrainsMono_VF as an uncompressed .ttf at 145 KiB, AnthropicSans_Italic 127 KiB and AnthropicSans_Roman 116 KiB. fonts.json drew only Anthropic Sans and Anthropic Serif Light in the first 400 text nodes at 1440.
findings.before: The home page downloads both italics and a TrueType monospace face it does not draw on the first screens.
findings.after: Serve the monospace face as woff2 and load it, and the italics, only on pages that set them; keep the roman faces preloaded.
findings.why: On a phone line the fonts are the page's largest cost: 855 KiB of 1952 KiB known.

findings.title: Room for other languages
findings.where: Header buttons 'Commitments' and 'Try Claude' (#base-ui-… triggers), 1440px, tiles/1440-00.png
findings.evidence: controls.fixed_width_buttons_tight: 'Commitments' box 139px, text 89px, room_for_longer_text_pct 25, nowrap; 'Try Claude' box 117px, text 67px, 33%, nowrap. The stylesheet carries :lang(hi), :lang(ja) and :lang(ko) rules, so the design system expects other languages.
findings.before: Two header triggers hold fixed widths with a quarter to a third of room for a longer label.
findings.after: Size the triggers to their content (width: auto with padding) and let the nav collapse into the menu earlier when the row runs out of room.
findings.why: A translated 'Commitments' (German 'Verpflichtungen' is about 35% longer) will clip or push the row.

findings.title: Content and navigation do not depend on script
findings.where: Reveal-animated blocks below the first screen, all widths
findings.evidence: resilience.hidden_content: scripts off shows 1068 of 1657 characters (64.5%) and an observer that never fires shows 1102 (66.5%), while reduced motion shows 1652 (99.7%). The sweep's hidden_content hits (ROB-001, Floor) record 450 characters with JavaScript off. The capture does not record which blocks are lost.
findings.before: Text waits for a scroll-triggered reveal; with reduced motion it shows, without script it does not.
findings.after: Gate the hidden starting state behind a class that script adds, so the default HTML shows the text.
findings.why: The reduced-motion path already proves the copy can stand without the reveal; scripts-off visitors and failed bundles lose a third of the page.

strengths: The model cards stretch to the longest title and description and keep the 'Model Details' and 'System Card' rows aligned at the bottom (tiles/1280-01.png).
Logical properties outnumber physical ones (539 to 471, 68 start and end), and the stylesheet has :lang rules for Hindi, Japanese and Korean.
Four font faces carry metric overrides, and 20 height rules use dvh or svh against 11 in vh.
The document fits every viewport (360 at 375, 1265 at 1280), with no overflow and no phone-parity loss; lab LCP is 560 ms.
Dates use one month-first long style ('Nov 9, 2026', 'Sep 22, 2026').
